subject: Supplier payment activation: next steps and documentation checklist
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@glacial.ai>, accounts@glacial.ai
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-09T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Supplier payment activation: next steps and documentation checklist

Hi Jane —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood. To get payments enabled and a PO issued, we need a short set of procurement docs from Glacial AI. Can you please provide the items below by EOD Tuesday (2027-05-11)? If any items need more time, flag them and we can prioritize what’s blocking the PO.

Required:
- Completed W-8BEN-E (signed PDF) or W-9 if you’re a US entity
- VAT registration certificate or equivalent (for non-US EU vendors)
- Legal entity name + remittance address (formal letterhead or government registry output)
- Banking details (bank name, SWIFT/IBAN for international payments) — we prefer a bank letter but a bank statement is acceptable

Optional but helps speed:
- Signed supplier onboarding form (attached template)
- Any local tax IDs or VAT rates you charge

Attachments: I attached the Redwood supplier onboarding template and our PO terms. Once we receive the W-8/W-9 and bank details, Marcus on Finance will issue a PO and route for signature.

Next steps:
1) You upload the completed forms to the Drive link (or reply with attachments).
2) Marcus will create PO_4567 and loop Marissa for SOW/tech acceptance.
3) Payments will be enabled after PO is signed and banking verified.

If you’d like a quick 15-minute call to run through the docs, happy to set one up — suggest tomorrow at 10am PT.

Thanks,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference

Hi Sofia —

Thanks — we can get most of that over to you this week. Quick questions:
1) We are a UK-registered entity and will provide a W-8BEN-E. Does Redwood need the full company registration extract in addition to the VAT cert?
2) For banking, is an ACH-friendly US bank required for USD payments, or can we use our UK account and get paid by SWIFT?

We attached the completed W-8BEN-E and a scan of our VAT certificate. I also attached a redacted bank letter showing account ownership.

Sofia —

I reviewed the attachments Jane sent. W-8BEN-E looks complete; VAT certificate present; bank letter acceptable for initial verification. Two notes from Finance:
- We need the legal entity registered name to exactly match the name on the W-8BEN-E and bank docs (please confirm Glacial’s legal entity string).
- PO will be drafted subject to acceptance of our standard payment terms (net 45 by default). If Glacial needs net30, that needs escalation to Procurement leadership.

I’ll prepare PO_4567 in draft and attach it here for internal review. Marissa — once we have legal-entity confirmation from Jane, please confirm the SOW acceptance so we can attach it to the PO.

Jane —

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the attachments. A couple quick clarifications so we can close this out this week:
- Please confirm the legal entity as: Glacial AI Ltd. (exact capitalization/spelling).
- Confirm whether Glacial prefers payments by SWIFT to the UK account you provided or if you can accept USD via our US partner account (we can enable ACH if you open a US bank account).

Once we have the entity string confirmed I’ll ask Marcus to finalize the PO and push the DocuSign envelope. If you can sign the PO quickly then the supplier record will be activated and first invoice can be paid after the PO is matched.

If any of the items above are blocked, let me know and we’ll schedule a 15-minute call to get unblocked.

Thanks,
